headline: Roblox: the 2006 story
title: Roblox Facts | From DynaBlocks to Billions | Classic Games
video_script: Roblox was created by David Baszucki and Erik Cassel, and was released to the public on September first, two thousand six. Early versions were tested under the name DynaBlocks. Players use the virtual currency Robux, and games are built with a version of the Lua language called Luau. Did you play Roblox as a kid? Comment below!
description: Roblox released September 1, 2006 by David Baszucki and Erik Cassel. Sources: Wikipedia, ExitLag history.
joke: My Robux balance and I have a very short relationship.
